glosses: to grip; to engulf; to overwhelm (to take over someone)

examples.translation: Fear gripped him.
examples.english: Fear gripped him.

examples.translation: He was so overcome with grief...
examples.english: He was so overcome with grief...

examples.translation: Sleep is about to take me.
examples.english: Sleep is about to take me.

glosses: to encompass (to cover with one's reach)

examples.translation: chaos has gripped
examples.english: chaos has gripped

glosses: to embrace (to surround with ones arms)

examples.translation: She took me into her arms.
examples.english: She took me into her arms.

glosses: to get, to grok (to understand and comprehend)

examples.translation: I've finally gotten it!
examples.english: I've finally gotten it!

glosses: to tidy up (to restore order, to tidy or clean)

examples.translation: I need to finally get my apartment in order...
examples.english: I need to finally get my apartment in order...

examples.text: Ogarnicie te pecyska, coby sie spaliło do cysta.
examples.translation: Clean up those furnaces so that they were burned clean.
examples.english: Clean up those furnaces so that they were burned clean.

glosses: to get (to be able to make something happen)

examples.translation: She's already gotten her life together.
examples.english: She's already gotten her life together.

glosses: to engulf (to surround on all sides)

examples.translation: They're about to surround us!
examples.english: They're about to surround us!

glosses: to check out (to emcompass with a glance)
to scoop, to push something around something; to sprinkle
to concentrate (to gather many things into one place)
to accommodate
to take possession
to close
to stroke the top of something
to dress up (to put someone in nice clothes)

examples.translation: They dressed him up in a formal clothing.
examples.english: They dressed him up in a formal clothing.

examples.text: Pojmij se sirotę, ogarnij. Dorobis sie chleba.
examples.translation: Get the orphan ready, dress him up. You will bake an extra loaf of bread.
examples.english: Get the orphan ready, dress him up. You will bake an extra loaf of bread.

glosses: to take, to get

examples.text: Ogarnoł po ojcu i fortune i cały dobytek.
examples.translation: He got both the estate and all the livestock from his dad
examples.english: He got both the estate and all the livestock from his dad

glosses: to cover
to happen to someone (to become someone's experience or to come upon someone)
to give (to send something to someone, to bestow something on someone)
to express something, to describe; to reflect
to get oneself together (to tidy up one's clothes and hair)

examples.translation: I have to get myself together before the date.
examples.english: I have to get myself together before the date.

glosses: to get oneself together (to overcome a moment of weakness and gather strength for something)

examples.text: Ogarniemy się i wszystko będzie w porządku, dobra?
examples.translation: We'll get ourselves together and everything will be okay, alright?
examples.english: We'll get ourselves together and everything will be okay, alright?

glosses: to deal with (to get rid of someone or something undesirable)

examples.text: Kiedy w końcu ogarną się ze śniegiem?
examples.translation: When will they finally deal with the snow?
examples.english: When will they finally deal with the snow?

glosses: to cope with, to pull off (to perform and complete a task despite difficulties)

examples.text: Jest mi trudno ogarnąć się z tym wszystkim.
examples.translation: It's hard for me to cope with all of this.
examples.english: It's hard for me to cope with all of this.

glosses: to dress up (to put on nice clothes)

examples.text: Ogarnijta sie porządnie, coby nie było me was wstyd.
examples.translation: Dress nicely so that I don't feel ashamed of you.
examples.english: Dress nicely so that I don't feel ashamed of you.

examples.text: Ślachcianka... nie ogarnie mi sie, kieby jaka mamka.
examples.translation: Noblewoman... I won't get dressed up like such a mother.
examples.english: Noblewoman... I won't get dressed up like such a mother.

glosses: synonym of stłuścieć (“to become fat”)

examples.text: Krowy organeły sie niedługo po ty chorobe.
examples.translation: The cows got fat shortly after this disease.
examples.english: The cows got fat shortly after this disease.

glosses: zob. ogarniać

examples.text: Przed wyjściem z domu ogarnęłam kuchnię.

glosses: обнять, обхватить руками
окружить, обступить, расположившись вокруг
плотно окружить
окутать, обволочь, обнять или обдать со всех сторон
воен. обойти противника с фланга или с обоих флангов с целью нанесения удара
перен. включить в себя, в свой состав, в свое содержание
вовлечь в круг действия, влияния чего-либо; включить в сферу своего действия, влияния
включить в поле зрения, окинуть взглядом
перен. всесторонне познать, постичь
перен. овладеть кем-либо; захватить (о чувствах, мыслях, впечатлениях, о физическом состоянии, болезненных ощущениях)
zob. ogarniać

examples.text: Jak ty wyglądasz? Ogarnij się, bo zaraz przychodzą goście.
